case.pattern_description: Coordinated card-not-present fraud using device D004630 (Samsung Galaxy S7 Edge SM-G935F on Chrome 62.0 for Android) routing through an anonymous proxy with anonymous recipient emails. The device operates across multiple compromised card accounts in ring 57672119 without fitting standard CNP burst typologies, as previously documented in closed fraud cases CC-2649, CC-2985, CC-2971, and CC-3035.
connected_device_profiles: SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080

evidence.claim: All four prior closed cases on device D004630 (CC-2649, CC-2971, CC-2985, and CC-3035) were confirmed fraudulent with pattern undocumented, involving unauthorized online purchases from this specific Samsung SM-G935F profile behind an anonymous proxy.
Device D004630 is the linking device of fraud ring 57672119, connecting five cards (C06617-K1, C03528-K1, C12132-K2, C09998-K1, C09733-K1), each of which has confirmed fraud closed cases.

Flagged transaction 3457285 was initiated online via device D004630, marked as New for this account, routed through an anonymous proxy (IP_PROXY:ANONYMOUS), and used an anonymous recipient email domain.
Transaction 3457285 was assigned a low model score of 0.012 with a historical fraud rate of 0.006, and a legacy risk score of 0.16.
Transaction 3457285 occurred in region 181, which is the card's most common billing region, representing 23 of 41 lifetime card transactions.

In the 7-day window surrounding transaction 3457285, recipient email anonymous.com had a fraud lift of 0.57 and region 181 had a fraud lift of 0.10, with no other card active on device D004630 in that period.

case.summary: Transaction 3457285 ($159.30) on card C10326-K1 was flagged due to the appearance of device D004630, which was new to the account and identified as the core device of fraud ring 57672119. Graph analysis revealed that device D004630 operated behind an anonymous proxy and was tied to four previous confirmed fraud cases (CC-2649, CC-2971, CC-2985, and CC-3035) spanning five compromised cards. However, the transaction matched the cardholder's historical billing region and received an exceptionally low model score of 0.012, yielding an overall fraud probability of 0.24. Due to the tension between high-risk cross-card device linkages and exculpatory transaction characteristics, the case is left uncertain and escalated to an analyst.
